title: North and South Pontotoc move into separate basketball regions in 2027
excerpt: The county rivals have two boys district games on the schedule this winter. North will join Region 2 and South will join Region 4 next season.
locality: Pontotoc, North Pontotoc and South Pontotoc high schools in Pontotoc County, Mississippi.

facts.statement: North Pontotoc will host South Pontotoc on Dec. 15, and South will host the Jan. 19 return game. Both boys varsity schedules list 7:30 p.m. tips. These are region games this winter. Beginning in 2027–28, the Mississippi High School Activities Association will put the county rivals in separate Class 4A basketball regions.
facts.evidence: Both boys schedules list Dec. 15, 2026 at North and Jan. 19, 2027 at South, each at 7:30 p.m. and marked as a district game. The MHSAA assignments put North in 4A Region 2 and South in 4A Region 4 for 2027–29.

paragraphs.text: North Pontotoc will host South Pontotoc on Dec. 15, and South will host the Jan. 19 return game. Both boys varsity schedules list 7:30 p.m. tips. These are region games this winter. Beginning in 2027–28, the Mississippi High School Activities Association will put the county rivals in separate Class 4A basketball regions.

North Pontotoc will move to Region 2. New Albany makes the move with North, while Byhalia, Clarksdale and Senatobia round out the five-team group. New Albany is the only one of North’s current region opponents that will stay on its region schedule.
South Pontotoc will play in Region 4 with Amory, Houston, Louisville and Shannon. All four will be new region opponents for South.

Pontotoc High’s region schedule will look more familiar. The Warriors remain in Class 5A Region 1 with Caledonia, Columbus, Lafayette, New Hope and West Point, the same five opponents listed for the current cycle.
